title: A Noetherian valuation ring that is not a field is a DVR
statement: Let $V$ be a commutative integral domain, with fraction field $F$. Assume that $V$ is a valuation ring [def-trf-valuation-ring], is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and is not a field (there exists $v\ne0$ in $V$ with no multiplicative inverse in $V$). Then $V$ is a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring].

source.place: Tag 00II (algebra-lemma-valuation-ring-Noetherian-discrete), forward implication with the field alternative excluded.
